about.title: What is Barakah FX Management?
body: Barakah FX Management is a premium forex trading account management service designed for busy traders who want steady, professional growth without spending hours in front of charts.
We operate on a performance-based profit-share model: you provide the capital, we provide the expertise and the trading system. We only share profits — never losses.
highlights: Capital stays in your own broker account

security.title: Your security is non-negotiable
items: Funds never leave your broker account — we only place trades
Hard 25% drawdown stop — trading pauses automatically at the threshold
Full trade transparency — every position, profit and loss visible on your terminal
No hidden fees — you only pay when you profit

faqs.question: What is Barakah FX Management?
faqs.answer: A professional forex account management service that trades Gold (XAUUSD) and EURUSD using rules-based strategies. Your funds remain in your own MT4/MT5 broker account while we manage the trading on your behalf.

faqs.question: Do you have access to withdraw my money?
faqs.answer: No. We cannot withdraw, transfer or deposit your funds. We only receive your MT4/MT5 trading password, which allows us to place and manage trades. Your account and withdrawals remain fully under your control.

faqs.question: Which brokers do you support?
faqs.answer: We currently support Exness, RoboForex, XM, FBS, Markets4you, IC Markets and AvaTrade. If you already have an account with another regulated broker, contact us to check compatibility.

faqs.question: Can I stop or pause the service anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can revoke trade permissions instantly by contacting us on Telegram. Open trades are then closed at market.

faqs.question: What is the minimum investment?
faqs.answer: The minimum is $1,000 for the Starter plan. Larger investments qualify for lower profit-sharing rates.

faqs.question: How do you charge for the service?
faqs.answer: It is performance-based: there are no monthly management fees and no hidden charges. We only earn a percentage of the profit generated. If there is no profit, you pay nothing.

faqs.question: What level of risk should I expect?
faqs.answer: Forex trading always carries risk, and profits are never guaranteed. We use strict risk management, including a maximum 25% drawdown limit, and disciplined position sizing to protect capital.

faqs.question: Can I monitor my account at any time?
faqs.answer: Yes. Because the account is in your name, you can log in to your MT4 or MT5 platform at any time to view open trades, balance, equity and complete trading history.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: Open a supported broker account, deposit at least $1,000, then share your MT4/MT5 trading password — never your withdrawal credentials. We begin managing the account while you monitor every trade.
